label: early original-phase positions (t=2-4), gated by which tokens came first
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase, 99.9% of mass. It never fires at t=0, never in the copy phase, and barely at the delimiter. It is concentrated at steps 2-4 (88% of mass; steps 1-5 give 99%). Only about 20% of steps in that window are active, so the content of the prefix sets whether it crosses threshold. Rates are higher when the first or recent previous tokens are p or 2 (about 3-4x lift), and somewhat higher for u, h, o, m, r and k. The current input matters too: z, 1, m and 2 are high, and first occurrences fire more than repeats (in_first lift 1.6x vs 0.3x). Top activations come from prefixes like p p 2, r 2 2 and 2 p 2 at steps 2-3. Activation often stays on over several consecutive early steps and then decays. Adding token-set conditions (seen p/2/u/h/o/m/r/k) raised precision to about 0.5 at most, at a large cost in recall, so the token dependence looks graded and additive rather than a clean rule. It does not fire on late original positions (t>=6) or on any output step.
